name: Oscar von Gilbert
original_name: オスカー・フォン・ジルベール
source:
“If you could leave Britain and go to another country, would you want to?”

The Cavendish family’s personal physician and Alice Charotte’s tutor. He lives on the estate to treat the countess’s illness. His family is a fairly prominent one that has produced several skilled military doctors and physicians, but he moved from his native Germany to Britain after being involved in a certain incident in the past.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
